cd /workspace/task && python3 -c "
import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('init.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']
year = ws['O11'].value
days = [31,28,30,31,30,31,31,30,31,30,31]
if year % 4 == 0 and (year % 100 != 0 or year % 400 == 0):
    days[1] = 29
total = sum(days)
night = [ws.cell(9,c).value for c in range(2,14)]
pct = [n/total for n in night]
for i,p in enumerate(pct):
    if p == 0:
        v = 0
    elif p == int(p):
        v = round(p,1)
    else:
        v = round(p,9)
    ws.cell(11, i+2).value = v
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('saved')
"
